items.q: when I worked there in 1950 the management kind of panicked at the thoughts that Lena Horne would draw a mixed crowd.

ctx.x: At the Coconut Grove were there a

mixed racial patronage, or not? I ask because when I worked there in 1950 the management kind of panicked at the thoughts that Lena Horne would draw a mixed crowd. They said, "We can't have that. We don't want anybody but white people in here."
